azureTrayAppRegistrationObjectId.value: <object ID of the AzureTray app registration — fill in or leave blank to let Deploy.ps1 resolve it>

logAnalyticsWorkspaceId._comment: Required. The app runs from a package, so filesystem log streaming is off and App Insights is the only place its logs land - and the alert rules query it.

alertEmailAddress._comment: Required. Receives the orphaned-grant, stuck-revocation and timer-silent alerts. An alert nobody receives leaves an open firewall hole looking like a healthy system.
